description: Welcome to this spacious and versatile 4-bedroom, 3-bath home in the highly desirable Westlake area of Natomas. With 2,653 sq ft of living space and 5,355 sq ft lot, this home offers a functional layout perfect for growing families, multigenerational living, or anyone needing extra flexibility.  Step inside and be immediately impressed by a stunning open-concept layout, where the living, dining, and kitchen areas flow seamlessly beneath vaulted ceilings, flooding the place with natural light and creating an airy, grand first impression perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.  The main level features a full bedroom and bathroom—ideal for guests or extended family—along with an additional bonus room that can be used as a playroom or gym. Upstairs, three more bedrooms and a generous loft provides even more living space for relaxation or to turn into a home office.  Located in a quiet, established neighborhood, you’re just minutes from parks, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes—with easy access to Downtown Sacramento and Sacramento International Airport.  This is a rare opportunity to own a well-sized home in one of Natomas’ most convenient and family-friendly communities.  Schedule your private showing today.
